name: IntelliQuiz
description: IntelliQuiz is a full-stack AI-powered quiz application built with Next.js, React.js, and MongoDB, featuring secure JWT-based authentication for user sign-up and login. The core highlight of the project is its deep integration with the Google Gemini AI API, which auto-generates quiz questions from any topic using structured prompts and customizable difficulty modes, eliminating the need for a static question bank. I built RESTful APIs using Next.js serverless functions and Mongoose ODM to handle quiz sessions, user scores, and data persistence. The UI includes a responsive countdown timer, real-time score tracking, and a student performance analytics dashboard for reviewing past results. This project demonstrates my ability to integrate cutting-edge AI APIs into production-grade full-stack applications with a focus on dynamic content generation and scalable architecture.
highlights: Deep integration with Google Gemini AI API to dynamically generate questions on any subject and difficulty level.
Built Next.js serverless REST APIs with JWT authentication and Mongoose ODM for secure session and score persistence.
Designed an interactive student analytics dashboard with real-time countdown timer and score tracking.

name: Registration Management System Viplava 2024
description: As a voluntary Full Stack Developer for Viplava 2024, a youth anti-addiction festival organized by ISKCON Youth Forum, I developed a complete registration management system that efficiently handled over 700 registrations. I built a responsive landing page, implemented secure form validation, integrated both online and offline payment options, and created a referral system to boost outreach. Additionally, I automated email confirmations using the Gmail API to streamline communication and reduce manual follow-up. This project allowed me to contribute technically to a meaningful cause, supporting event coordination and improving the overall registration experience.
highlights: Handled 700+ live registrations with online/offline payment validation and 99% uptime during peak event traffic.
Automated instant email confirmations and tickets using Gmail API, cutting manual coordination effort by 70%.
Built a custom referral system and organizer workflow to track promotional outreach across volunteer teams.

name: BlogApplication
description: A production-ready blog platform built using Next.js that showcases advanced full-stack development skills and innovative content management. The application features a custom file-based CMS using Markdown for blog posts, with custom parsing powered by gray-matter and JSX rendering through react-markdown. I developed dynamic routing, implemented server-side rendering and static site generation for optimal performance, and created reusable components including hero sections, navigation systems, post grids, and layouts. The platform integrates MongoDB for contact form submissions through RESTful API routes, utilizes React Portals for UI notifications, and includes custom head management for SEO optimization. I also implemented react-syntax-highlighter for beautiful code snippet rendering within blog posts.
highlights: Architected custom file-based Markdown CMS with gray-matter parsing and syntax highlighting.
Implemented Next.js SSR and Static Site Generation (SSG) for fast initial loads and SEO optimization.
Integrated MongoDB for contact form submissions via RESTful API routes and React Portals for UI notifications.

name: Restaurant App
description: Built a responsive and feature-rich restaurant web application using Next.js, MongoDB, and CSS, aimed at helping restaurants manage their online menus and customer interactions. The app offers a smooth user experience with secure sign-up, dynamic menu browsing, and a smart cart system that ensures users can order from only one restaurant at a time. For restaurant owners, the platform includes an intuitive dashboard to update menus in real-time, with the ability to add, edit, or remove food items effortlessly. This project showcases practical full-stack development, user-focused design, and real-time data handling, ideal for modern restaurant operations.
highlights: Built a single-restaurant smart cart validation system to streamline orders and eliminate multi-vendor conflicts.
Created an intuitive real-time admin dashboard for restaurant owners to update, add, or delete menu items.
Implemented secure authentication and dynamic menu categorization using Next.js and MongoDB.

name: Event Management & Admin Dashboard System
description: I developed a voluntary event registration and management system for a society, designed to streamline participant registration and attendance tracking. The system includes an admin dashboard where organizers can view and manage attendee details, monitor event attendance in real time, and maintain a centralized participant database. The project was built using Next.js for the frontend and server-side rendering, with MongoDB as the database to store and manage participant information efficiently. Node.js and Express were used for backend APIs and data handling, integrated seamlessly within the Next.js application. This solution improved the society’s event organization workflow while reducing manual tracking.
highlights: Built a centralized attendee database and real-time dashboard for event organizers.
Automated participant attendance tracking and eliminated paper-based record keeping.
Developed backend RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express integrated into Next.js.

name: Shopping Cart App
description: An e-commerce web application built with React.js, Redux, and Tailwind CSS. It features a clean, intuitive user interface with smooth navigation and dynamic cart functionality. Users can browse products, add or remove items, and see real-time price updates without page reloads. The design focuses on simplicity and a seamless shopping experience.
highlights: Implemented global state management with Redux for synchronous cart calculations and instant item updates.
Designed a modern, responsive UI with Tailwind CSS optimized for mobile and desktop screens.

name: Expense Tracker
description: A simple and efficient web application for tracking income and expenses, built with React.js, Redux, and CSS. It allows users to easily record transactions, categorize them, and maintain a clear overview of their financial activity. Designed with a clean interface for smooth navigation and effortless expense management.
highlights: Engineered clean state flow with Redux for tracking multiple income/expense categories in real-time.
Built intuitive transaction ledger with interactive balance summary.
